text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Pengangkutan Jalan

(Larangan Penggunaan Jalan) (Jalan Persekutuan) (No. 17) 2023.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 31 Julai 2023.

Larangan

2. Pemanduan atau penggunaan kenderaan motor dan jentera bergerak yang

mempunyai berat tanpa muatan sepuluh ribu kilogram dan lebih ("kenderaan berat")

di atas bahagian jalan yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) Jadual Pertama sebagaimana

yang ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual Kedua, pada hari dan masa yang dinyatakan

dalam ruang (2) Jadual Pertama, dilarang.

Pengecualian

3. Pengecualian daripada larangan itu hendaklah diberikan bagi maksud dan dalam

hal keadaan yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual Ketiga.

JADUAL PERTAMA

(1)

Jalan yang baginya

Larangan Terpakai

(2)

Hari dan Masa Larangan

Laluan 3111, Jalan Permatang Pauh

dari koordinat U 5.365138, T 100.425197

hingga U 5.412325, T 100.408424

Tiap-tiap hari

(kecuali hari kelepasan am)

Pagi : 6.30 pagi hingga 8.30 pagi

Petang : 5.00 petang hingga 7.00 malam

JADUAL KEDUA

JADUAL KETIGA

PENGECUALIAN

1. Bagi maksud penyelenggaraan, pembaikan, peningkatan, pembersihan

dan pemugaran bahagian jalan yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) Jadual Pertama.

2. Bagi maksud pemacakan, pemasangan, penyelenggaraan, pengubahan

atau pengalihan mana-mana struktur, kerja, peralatan atau apa-apa benda

di dalam, di bawah atau di atas bahagian jalan yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1)

Jadual Pertama.

3. Bagi maksud perkhidmatan kecemasan dan penguatkuasaan oleh agensi Kerajaan

dan pihak berkuasa tempatan.

4. Bagi maksud pemeriksaan, pembuangan dan penghantaran sisa domestik

oleh kenderaan berat seperti lori sampah, lori pembersihan pembentungan

dan lori vakum pembentungan.

5. Bagi maksud kecemasan jika penggunaan mana-mana jalan selain yang terdapat

dalam koordinat yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) Jadual Pertama menjadi

mustahil atau tidak sesuai.

Dibuat 28 Julai 2023

[KKR.100-1/2/79 Jld.6; PN(PU2)460/Jld. 126]

DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

 Menteri Kerja Raya

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

ROAD TRANSPORT (PROHIBITION OF USE OF ROAD)

(FEDERAL ROADS) (NO. 17) ORDER 2023

WHEREAS by P.U. (B) 258/2023 published on 13 July 2023, notice was given

of the intention to make an order under section 70 of the Road Transport Act 1987

[Act 333]:

AND WHEREAS no objection was received by the Minister of Works against the making

of such order:

NOW THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 70 of the Act,

the Minister of Works, after taking into consideration the matters referred to

in subsection 70(2) of the Act, makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Road Transport (Prohibition of Use

of Road) (Federal Roads) (No. 17) Order 2023.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 31 July 2023.

Prohibition

2. The driving or use of motor vehicles and mobile machineries with the unladen

weight of ten thousand kilogrammes and more ("heavy vehicles") on the part of the road

as specified in column (1) of the First Schedule as shown on the map

in the Second Schedule, on the day and time specified in column (2) of the First Schedule,

is prohibited.

Exemption

3. Exemption from such prohibition shall be given for the purposes and in

circumstances specified in the Third Schedule.

FIRST SCHEDULE

(1)

Road to which

Prohibition Applies

(2)

Day and Time Prohibition

Route 3111, Permatang Pauh Road

from coordinate N 5.365138,

E 100.425197 until N 5.412325,

E 100.408424

Everyday

(except public holiday)

Morning : 6.30 a.m. to 8.30 a.m.

Evening : 5.00 p.m. to 7.00 p.m.

SECOND SCHEDULE

THIRD SCHEDULE

EXEMPTION

1. For the purposes of maintenance, repair, improvement, cleaning and clearance

of the part of road specified in column (1) of the First Schedule.

2. For the purposes of erection, installation, maintenance, alteration or removal

of any structure, works, apparatus or anything in, under or over the part

of the road specified in column (1) of the First Schedule.

3. For the purposes of emergency services and enforcement by the Government

agencies and local authorities.

4. For the purposes of checking, disposal and delivery of domestic waste by heavy

vehicle such as garbage truck, sewerage cleaning truck and sewerage

vacuum truck.

5. For the purposes of emergency if the use of any road other than which appears

in the coordinate specified in column (1) of the First Schedule is rendered

impossible or unsuitable.

Made 28 July 2023

[KKR.100-1/2/79 Jld.6; PN(PU2)460/Jld. 126]

 DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

 Minister of Works
